\caption{Retrieval against existing methods. Every method we ran uses the Nomic embedding unless named, and PPR and BoundedField run the recipe of each benchmark's mode, tuned on the embedder named: \term{survey} on SurveyMatch and SurGE, \term{frontier} and \term{consensus} on their own, and \term{focused} on PaSa and ScholarCatalyst. Bold marks the best of our runs in each column, and an underline the best of every row, reported ones included. $^\dagger$ and $^\ddagger$ mark a score significantly below BoundedField on Nomic 0.5B and on Nemotron 8B, by a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-case scores, Holm-corrected over the 260 comparisons against each, $p < 0.05$. Reported rows have no per-case scores and are not tested.}
